verdict.rationale: Google's support docs explicitly describe controls to review prompts, delete Gemini Apps activity, and turn off 'Keep Activity' (gemini-docs-31), plus explicit statements that chats/files are not used for model training by default (gemini-docs-38) while audio/video in Gemini Live can be opted in/out of training use (gemini-docs-37) — directly matching retention/deletion control for an AI-native user. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that deletion actually removes data, and detail on data export or full account-level deletion workflows.
